title: National Fund For Cultural Heritage Amendment Act 1997

sections.shortTitle: National Fund For Cultural Heritage Amendment Act 1997
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 1998
ACT I OF 1998
NATIONAL FUND FOR
CULTURAL HERITAGE (AMENT)MENT) ACT, 1997
An Act to amend
the National Fund for
Cultural Heritage
Act, 1994
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
14th January,
1998]
The following Act by
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 5th
January, 1998, and is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the National Fund for Cultural
Heritage (Amendment) Act, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
